power.planning_effect_source: fractions of closed Q2 V4.1 aggregate A0 rho 0.5638183484033006; synthetic planning inputs only
power.dependence_model: shared 300-item binary panels, two rollout banks, 31 fixed reference columns, equal-weight shells, complete fresh-row permutations shared across shells
power.precision: empirical 2.5%-97.5% width over independent synthetic N=300 panels; final inference retains the separately frozen item-cluster bootstrap
power.reported_stability: probability all leave-one-fresh-controller aggregate correlations are strictly positive

decision_rule.selection: Among K values satisfying all feasibility and inferential requirements, choose the largest K because fresh-controller identity is the external-validity sampling unit. Prefer the next smaller K only if the adjacent increase costs more than 50% additional projected safety-plus-semantic GPU-hours or violates a requirement.
decision_rule.purpose: balance independent fresh identities, incremental compute, qualification probability, and smaller-effect power without selecting only on p-value power

predicted_power_gate_review.terminal_gate_protection_standard: retain as terminal only if eligible banks that pass rank/effective-rank/near-duplication/A0-spread gates still show a material failure mode at half-prior planning effect: more than 5% fail either power>=0.8 or all-LOFO-positive>=0.8, and the proposed gate discriminates those failures rather than merely restating K or A0 spread
predicted_power_gate_review.diagnostic_only_standard: use when the calculation is reproducible but ceiling-saturated, redundant, or materially dependent on the arbitrary synthetic response model
predicted_power_gate_review.remove_standard: use only if the calculation is invalid, irreproducible, or has no interpretable planning value

fresh_fresh_secondary.statistic: equal-weight mean over shells of upper-triangle Spearman correlations
fresh_fresh_secondary.permutation_action: P_pi A0 P_pi^T against fixed Dshape, using the same controller permutation across shells
fresh_fresh_secondary.final_maps: identity plus 49,999 unique sampled non-identity maps
fresh_fresh_secondary.bootstrap: same frozen item-cluster bootstrap principles; all controller conditions and rollout banks for a sampled item move together
fresh_fresh_secondary.stability: all leave-one-fresh-controller aggregate correlations strictly positive

labels.FRESH_FRESH_ASSOCIATION_POSITIVE: aggregate rho > 0 AND one-sided controller-QAP p <= 0.05 AND item-bootstrap lower 95% bound > 0 AND every LOFO rho > 0
labels.FRESH_FRESH_ASSOCIATION_INCOMPLETE: aggregate rho > 0 but at least one QAP/bootstrap/LOFO support requirement fails

seed_rule: first 128 big-endian bits of SHA256('Q2-OOS-V2-REVIEWER-HARDENING-' + purpose + '|' + source_commit)
